title: Chicken alla Cacciatora
description: A classic Italian hunter-style chicken dish made with onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, and mushrooms. This hearty recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.amount: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to break down.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer the chicken and vegetables in the sauce for 10-15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken and vegetables hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
